name: Claude Code · Sonnet 5.5
prompt:
Make a launch video for a new product feature, in the Liquid Glass style (the glassy look of Apple's Liquid Glass).

Product: ultramotion, a library of motion templates.
New feature: Liquid Glass templates — turn one sentence into a vertical motion video with music.

Requirements:
- Vertical 1080×1920, 30 fps, 15–25 seconds
- Structure: open on the product name → show the new feature in 2–3 scenes → end with a tagline and the product name
- Include music and sound effects; export one mp4 with audio to the current directory
